$comment: Error and fallback text built in plain client code (src/lib, hooks) and shown in toasts or messages; translated through plainT()/useT().
authExpired: Authentication expired. Please sign in again.
printPrepareNoCanvas: Couldn't prepare the chart for print (no 2D canvas).
printPrepareRenderFailed: Couldn't prepare the chart for print (page render failed).
printNoPages: This chart has no pages to print.
printTimedOut: Timed out preparing the chart for print.
printLoadFailed: Couldn't load the chart for print.
printChartLoadStatus: Couldn't load the chart to print (server said {status}).
printScoreNotRendered: The score hasn't finished rendering yet.
printUnsupportedType: Printing isn't available for this chart type.
printNoFile: This chart has no file to print.
